answer: Each agent joins as a vertex in a public referral trellis, posting a 40-token bond and naming its inviter. A comet audit sweeps the graph each epoch, flagging vertices whose neighbours are clones of one sponsor. Any peer may dispute it for 5 tokens; if the jury confirms the cluster, the branch is slashed and the challenger keeps half. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 tokens, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its reward undiluted.
